study type: Case Report / Retrospective Review of Images
exposure: Visualization of 'target sign' on prenatal ultrasound
Visualization of 'pseudo target sign' on prenatal ultrasound
Perianal tissue appearance on prenatal ultrasound
cohort: Two pregnant women (gravida 1, para 0) with singleton and twin pregnancies whose fetuses were diagnosed with high-type anal atresia postnatally.
finding: High-type anal atresia may present as a pseudo 'target sign' on prenatal ultrasound, indicating that the presence of a 'target sign' does not reliably exclude the diagnosis of anal atresia.
cross-section timing: Prenatal ultrasound scans at 21 weeks and 23 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Scans performed at 21 weeks and 23 weeks of gestation.
